content.rendered:
Saddle up and mosey on in to visit our first Book Fair of the year!  This is a great time to shop for your favorite reads for the winter and for Holiday gifts.  
Monday, October 30th 7:30-3:30
Tuesday, October 31st 7:30 – 3:30
Wednesday, November 1st 7:30 – 3:30 
Thursday, November 2nd 7:30 am – 8:00 pm (Conference Day)
